items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:42:1
items.html:
The three first ones of AA, which are the phase of the Rosh, and it requires much more light than the body etc.: because HGT of AA became Mochin for AVI. These matters are very deep, and they require elaboration at length. And first one must know that the matter of the clothing of the NHY of the upper one as Mochin in the lower one, and the matter of the lower one’s clothing of the Guf of the upper one, are two matters distinct from one another. For you see that the NHY of Atik clothe as Mochin in the Rosh of AA, and along with this the Rosh of AA clothes the HGT of Atik and not the NHY of Atik. And so it is with AVI: the NHY of AA clothe as Mochin in the Rosh of AVI, and along with this, the Roshim of AVI clothe only the HGT of AA and nothing at all of the NHY of AA. And the reason for this is simple, for those NHY of the upper one that clothe as Mochin in the lower one are the discernment of the NHY of the ten Sefirot of the Rosh of the upper one, and they have nothing at all to do with the lower one’s clothing of the Guf of the upper one.
And know that there are three discernments of the NHY of the upper one. The first are the NHY of the ten Sefirot of the Rosh of the upper one from its own emanation. The second are new NHY that are revealed in it through the raising of MAN [Mayin Nukvin] by the lower one. The third are new NHY that were revealed in it through the raising of MAN by the son of the lower one.
And let us understand these matters according to the order of emanation of the three Partzufim: Atik, AA and AVI. For you know that through the coupling of AB SAG, which brought the bottom Hey out of the forehead and lowered her to her place in the Peh, ten Sefirot came out at the level of Keter. This came about at first through the inclusion of the MAN of Nekudim in the Rosh of SAG; and afterwards, when the coarseness of the records became apparent, they descended to their place, to the Peh of Nekudim, and there they once more brought out ten Sefirot of Rosh, from the Peh of Nekudim down to the Tabur of AK, at the level of Keter, which is called the Rosh of Atik, as above (page 616, the passage beginning “And now”). And this sufficed for the discernment of the Rosh of Atik, but not for the discernment of its Guf, for the reason that the Bina of this Rosh stands, as is her way, in the discernment of the posterior toward Aba, and therefore she bestows upon the Guf only the discernments of Ruach and Nefesh alone, and the Guf is found lacking GAR [first three]. The emanation of the Rosh and the Guf of Atik has thus been explained; and now we shall explain the Partzuf AA.
The Partzuf AA was sorted out by the Nukva of Atik. For since she is the discernment of the upper half of the Keter of Nekudim, that is, the discernments of Galgalta ve Einayim of Keter, which came out at the beginning of its emanation — and now, through her joining with MA, she attained the GAR of Keter — she once more drew to herself her AHP from the time of Nekudim, that is, the NHY of Keter, which were annulled then because of the concealment of the GAR of Keter; and now that she has again attained the GAR through the new MA, she once more drew them to herself to complete her old ten Sefirot. And since these AHP contain also something of the discernments of the NHY of AK, that is, of the illumination of the Tabur of AK and the Yesod of AK, they therefore became MAN there, and caused the Bina of Atik to return face to face with Hochma. For it is known that the arrival of ZON in the place of Bina always arouses Bina to turn her face to Aba in order to draw the illumination of Hochma for the sake of ZON, since she has a connection with them, to supply them with the illumination of Hochma, by virtue of the relation of Bina and ZON in the ten Sefirot of direct light. And it is known that in these MAN there remained nothing but phase three of coarseness, since phase four, which was in the whole of the MAN, Atik took; and therefore nothing came out upon them but the level of Hochma, as is written in the Inner Light mentioned above.
It follows that the Nukva of Atik acquired, by virtue of this new coupling that came out in her, the discernment of her AHP from the time of Nekudim; that is, she was again completed as whole ten Sefirot, GE and AHP, yet not at the level that she has from MA, which is the level of Keter, but only at the level of Hochma. And it is now regarded that there are in the Nukva of Keter two discernments of NHY. The first, the NHY of Keter that she has from the vessels of MA. The second, the NHY of the level of Hochma that she has now attained through the new MAN of the AHP.
And behold, from this coupling two levels are drawn downwards. The first is to the Guf of Atik itself, for after the Bina of the Rosh returned face to face, its illumination reaches the Guf as well; and the Guf now gains the discernments of GAR, but only the GAR of the level of Hochma and not of the level of Keter as it is in the Rosh, since the face to face coupling that was made in the Rosh was only upon the discernments of the new MAN, in which there is no more than the coarseness of phase three, as above. And the second level is drawn to the discernment of the Rosh of AA, to the place of the Chazeh [chest] of Atik, which it clothes from the Chazeh up to the Peh.
Now you will understand the matter of the clothing of the NHY of the upper one as Mochin in the lower one, for in truth they are the portion of the lower one and they are not fit to remain in the upper one. For they are those very AHP that completed the Nukva of Atik at the time of the coupling upon the MAN of AA, as above. And although they were joined to her at the time of the coupling, they are nevertheless not fit to remain in her, since they are of the discernment of the level of Hochma; and moreover, after their own coarseness became apparent, their flaw from the time of Nekudim also became known, so that they are not fit to be found in the place of Atik, as above. And therefore they descend together with the level of the Rosh of AA, to the place of the Guf of Atik.
And it is fitting that you know here what the ARI writes further on, that all the Partzufim, at the time they are born, fall into Beria and nurse there from the two lower thirds of Netzah and Hod of Atik that are found there. And the reason for this is that this screen, which comprises all the records that are in the posterior of the NHY of Keter, and the four posteriors of AVI, and the ZAT — this screen is of the discernment of the Guf of Nekudim, which rose, after its refinement, to the discernment of the Rosh of SAG, as above. And from there it descended from degree to degree until it brought out all the Partzufim of ABYA. And therefore, since the Guf of Nekudim illuminated in all of BYA, as above in Part 7, before its own Guf coarseness became apparent — that is, while it was still included in the coarseness of the Rosh — it was able to be in the discernment of Atzilut. But after its own Guf coarseness became apparent, which is the time for the level to come out of the inclusion in the Rosh and to descend to its own place, that is, to the place where it was before its refinement, which is called the birth of the Partzuf, as is known — then there becomes apparent in the screen the bodily discernments of Nekudim that were in it before it was refined, when it was in the discernments of BYA. And therefore every single level that came out upon this screen was compelled to come to Beria at the hour of its birth, which means at the hour when its coarseness became apparent.
But through the nursing from the two lower thirds of Netzah and Hod of Atik, which are in Beria, they once more acquire the discernment of Atzilut that is in them, until they rise and clothe the Guf of the upper one, as is written in its place. And so it happened to AA as well, for after the Guf coarseness in the screen, which contained also something of the discernments of BYA, became apparent, it was compelled to come out of the discernment of the Rosh of Atik and to come to the place of Beria, beneath the Parsa of Atzilut, which is called the birth of the Partzuf, as above. It follows that the discernments of the NHY of the Mochin that it received from the upper one remain in the Guf of Atik; and after AA nursed from the two lower thirds of Atik and returned to Atzilut and clothed the HGT NHY of Atik, it then received once more the NHY of the upper Rosh, which clothed in it as Mochin. Thus it has been explained that AA’s first reception of the NHY of Atik was while it was still included in the coupling of the Rosh of Atik; but since at the time of its birth it was compelled to descend to Beria, it is therefore compelled to return a second time and to receive them from the HGT of Atik.
And in this way was the emanation of AVI through the Nukva of AA. For AVI were made from the discernment of the ZAT of HB of BON, that is, the AHP that were annulled from AVI after they lost their GAR. And since these ZAT of AVI were, in the time of Nekudim, in one degree with the NHY of the Keter of Nekudim, and also clothed in them as Mochin, therefore, after the Nukva of AA, which is the discernment of the NHY of the Keter of Nekudim, received the discernments of GAR through the coupling of Atik, she drew to herself also the discernment of the AHP of AVI, as MAN; and AA and the Nukva coupled face to face upon these MAN, as above with Atik, and brought out ten Sefirot at the level of Bina, for there remained in the records nothing but the coarseness of phase two, since phase three AA took for itself, as above. And through this coupling two levels came out, as above with Atik. One to the Guf of AA itself, which was previously only in the discernment of Nefesh and Ruach, since it could not receive from its own Rosh because of the Bina that stands in the posterior toward Aba; and now, through the MAN from AVI, by which they returned face to face, the Guf of AA too received the GAR, except that they are the GAR of phase two and not of phase three, as it has in the Rosh. And the second level came out to the Rosh of AVI, whose MAN they are.
And here too it is regarded that the NHY of AA clothed in the Rosh of AVI, that is, the discernments of AHP that the Nukva of AA took from the MAN in order to be completed with them into ten Sefirot at the time of the coupling, as above with Atik for the need of AA. And at the time AVI were born, that is, when their screen became apparent, they too descended to Beria, for that same reason mentioned with AA; and the discernments of the NHY and the Mochin remained in the Guf of AA, until, through the nursing, they returned to Atzilut and clothed the HGT of AA, and then they once more received the discernments of the NHY and the Mochin that are in them.
And you must know that AA cannot couple upon the MAN of AVI except when it joins and becomes one Partzuf with Atik, as the ARI writes further on. And this is for the reason that the Nukva of AA is only the lower half of the Keter of Nekudim, as above, which is the discernment of NHY alone; and in order to sort the MAN of AVI and to couple upon them, the Keter must be in its wholeness, as it was in the time of Nekudim, when it clothed in AVI of Nekudim as Mochin. And moreover, the essential coupling is reckoned by the name of the Nukva of Atik, for the lower half of Keter, at the time it joins with its upper half, is annulled and included in the upper one into one whole degree, and the lower one does not even come up by name, as above in the words of the ARI (page 398).
And according to this it follows that Atik bestows two kinds of Mochin for AA. The first are for the need of the Rosh of AA, which are ten Sefirot at the level of Hochma, as above, and they are clothed in the NHY of Atik that were revealed by virtue of this coupling in the Rosh of Atik, for these NHY descend together with the Mochin to AA, because they are not fit for Atik, as above. And the second Mochin that Atik bestows are for the Guf of AA. For the Guf of AA cannot receive the discernment of GAR from its own Rosh, since they are in the discernment of face to back; rather, only through the raising of the MAN of AVI do Atik and Arich return into one Partzuf, and HB of the Rosh too return face to face, and then the GAR descend and are bestowed upon the Guf of AA, as above. And since this coupling too is reckoned by the name of Atik, it turns out that even the Mochin of the Guf are bestowed from the coupling of Atik, except that they are from a lower level, being from the MAN of AVI, which is only phase two. And with this you will understand that the Mochin of phase two that are in the Guf of AA are likewise clothed in the NHY of Atik, that is, in the AHP with which the Nukva of Atik was completed at the time of the coupling of this level of phase two.
And thus the two couplings of Atik for the need of AA have been explained, and the two discernments of the NHY of Atik that clothe in AA: that the NHY of Atik from the level of Hochma clothe in the Rosh of AA, and the NHY of Atik from the level of Bina clothe in the Guf of AA.
And with this you will also understand that after the nursing of AVI, while they are still in Beria, from the two lower thirds of NH of Atik, by which they acquire the power to rise to Atzilut and to clothe the HGT of AA, as above — they then receive the NHY together with their Mochin, from the discernment of the NHY of Atik that are clothed in the HGT of AA.
And here you find three discernments of the NHY of the ten Sefirot of the Rosh of Atik. The first are the NHY of the ten Sefirot of the Rosh of Atik from its own emanation itself, which are of the level of Keter. The second are the NHY of the ten Sefirot of the Rosh of Atik that came out in it out of the inclusion of the MAN of AA, and they are the NHY of the level of Hochma, and they clothe in the Mochin of the Rosh of AA. The third are the NHY of the ten Sefirot of the Rosh of Atik that came out in it out of the inclusion of the MAN of AVI, and they are the NHY of the level of Bina, and they clothe in the Guf of AA, in its HGT; for AVI, which are the garments of the HGT of AA, receive the Mochin of GAR through these NHY of Atik that are clothed in the HGT of AA.
And this is his saying, “Since they are the three first ones of AA, which are the phase of the Rosh, and it requires much more light than the body, therefore each one of them was clothed with one complete Sefira of Atik.” That is to say, the HGT of Atik, which bestow the Mochin of the Rosh at the level of Hochma, as above, that is, through its return to Atzilut and its clothing of the HGT of Atik — therefore it needs all three Sefirot, the HGT of Atik, which become the KHB in it, and the essential illumination of AA comes from them. “But the seven lower ones, the body of AA, do not require as much light as the Rosh, and therefore the three last ones of Atik suffice to illuminate them,” that is, as above: the NHY of Atik that illuminate in the Guf of AA are an illumination lower than the level of Hochma of AA, and they are only of the level of Bina; and they too stand there mainly in order to illuminate the illumination of GAR in AVI, as above. And this is his saying, “And this is also because HGT later become Mochin in the three first ones of AVI, and therefore the main of their illumination is in the HGT of AA, to illuminate the Mochin of AVI,” that is, as explained, that the NHY of Atik that clothe in the Guf of AA bestow the Mochin of GAR upon AVI.
